correctness.rationale: Read complete RESULT.md and verifier, source tree. Affine cube coordinates make height signs ±A±B±C; a generic level cuts exactly those of 12 edges whose end heights straddle T. Sorting four positive heights gives piecewise intervals: A>=B+C counts 3,4,5,4; A<B+C counts 3,4,5,6. Dividing lengths by W yields each claimed probability, with p3=p5+2p6 and mean four. Conversely solve for A/W=(p3+p4+p5)/2, B/W=(p3+p4)/2,C/W=p3/2 when p6>0; given invertible generator matrix, any positive normalized triple is attained by some normal. On p6=0 set rho=p3=p5 and derive C/W=rho/2, B/W in [rho/2,(1-rho)/2], A/W complementary; unique at rho=1/2, nonunique otherwise. Variance 2(p3+p6) takes 0 at C=0 and 2 at A=B=C, sharp vertices. Independently enumerated all twelve edges for 342 nonzero integer projection triples in [0,6]^3 with exact rational offset intervals and compared laws, including zero projections/ties. Universal law follows piecewise sign-order proof, not the sample.

As normal varies, exactly all distributions with mean 4 are realized. The sorted relative projections are identifiable for p6>0, while the p6=0 inverse fiber is an explicit interval; section-count variance has sharp bounds 0<=Var<=2.
